summary: KE Holdings Inc., a Cayman-incorporated, NYSE-listed Chinese real-estate platform (HKEX: 02423), filed a Form 6-K on September 21, 2026 furnishing four HKEX Next Day Disclosure Returns dated September 14-17. The returns report a buyback program: shares repurchased but not yet cancelled, executed in Hong Kong at prices ranging roughly HKD 36.08 to HKD 45.01 per share across June 2026 dates, and in the US at approximately USD 5.71-5.72 per share in August 2026. Issued shares remain 3,300,858,110 with zero treasury shares. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium is stated. Watch the pace and cancellation cadence for EPS accretion and buyback-authorization runway.
